description: Reconstruction settings. 'config' holds the complete settings document (the reco.json of the RayBotic engine) and is the source of truth; the other attributes and the rois table repeat parts of it for tools that do not parse it. reconstructions/current is the configuration being edited; every run leaves an unchanged copy (status, volume set) next to it. Files 'config' names (bad pixel mask, jitter shifts) stay outside the scan. Detector corrections in 'config' (detector_shift, negate_detector_orientation) apply on top of the acquisition's stored geometry, which is final.

acquisition.description: Node path of the ct_acquisition whose projections are reconstructed.

roi_names.description: Name of each row of rois.

modified.description: ISO 8601 UTC, when 'config' was last written.

status.description: Runs only: running, ok, cancelled or failed.

volume.description: Runs only: node path of the volume it produced.

software.description: Runs only: engine name and version.

message.description: Runs only: error or warning text.

rois.description: One row per reconstruction region; time = when 'config' was written.

midpoint.description: Centre of the grid in the world frame.
